d115AuthenticatedActor.actor: Legacy LOCAL_UNAUTHENTICATED or AUTHENTICATED:<server-session username>; username matches [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}.
d115AuthenticatedActor.source: Only the authenticated trial controller supplies the session principal. Request body actor fields are rejected. Local callers preserve the legacy actor. Existing immutable revisions are not rewritten.
d115AuthenticatedActor.rollback: Older binaries require the legacy actor literal; after cloud revisions exist, rollback requires an actor-aware binary or separately reviewed configuration recovery, never edits to immutable evidence.

d102CategoryExtension.field: project.category: LARGE_APPLIANCE / SMALL_APPLIANCE / OTHER (大家电 / 小家电 / 其他)
d102CategoryExtension.compatibility: Optional in legacy v1/v2 documents and requests; omission defaults to OTHER, explicit null/unknown values reject. New immutable revisions and HTTP responses include category. Category participates in candidate hash and independent readback.
d102CategoryExtension.singleSource: Editable once in collection-account configuration; dashboard configuration and GET /api/projects derive from that same project metadata. No separately editable dashboard category.
d102CategoryExtension.identity: Category is display grouping only, not a fact/account/import identity dimension; reclassification preserves project ID/account binding and historical facts. Collector template and metric configuration stay shared.
d102CategoryExtension.rollback: Older binaries reject category as an unknown field; code rollback after category publication requires a compatible category-aware binary or a separately reviewed configuration rollback. Do not edit immutable revision files.

d080Extension.storageSchema: project-configuration-v2 remains compatible with v1/v2 historical documents
d080Extension.projectFields: optional publicDouyinId, awemeName, deleted (default false); HTTP GET emits null metadata and deleted:false, stored documents omit absent metadata and false deleted
d080Extension.pending: Nonempty valid publicDouyinId permits empty douyinIds and null awemeName. No manual lookup gate or online check on save. Without publicDouyinId at least one legacy numeric anchor remains required.
d080Extension.delete: Persisted deletion is deleted:true plus enabled:false, retains immutable id/account and historical configuration/facts. Restore sets deleted:false; existing rows cannot be physically removed. Unsaved drafts may be removed before submission.
d080Extension.directory: Only enabled and non-deleted projects appear; account lookup remains bound to each project, no fallback to another account when facts are empty.
d080Extension.plan: Enabled non-deleted public-ID projects emit publicDouyinId and douyinIds=[] regardless of stale cached anchors; collector resolves before report execution. Legacy no-public projects emit existing anchors. Offline plan does not execute lookup or reports.

implementationUnit.acceptance: Local maintenance preflight and explicit apply publish one immutable configuration revision; sidebar and project-owned dry-run collector plan read that same revision. Restart preserves it; stale/invalid/cross-origin writes fail without publication; disabling retains facts.
implementationUnit.scope: Project/account additions, names, enable/disable and anchor configuration; fixed material-33-v1 metric profile is visible but not editable until versioned acquisition/input compatibility is verified.

owners.core: current_fact_reader: backend configuration package and its tests
owners.collector: local_source_preflight: collector plan consumer and its tests after survey
owners.integration: main: api/local wiring, contract, independent verification, documentation

storage.location: Explicit private directory under workspace .local; no credentials in configuration
storage.documents: Immutable revisions/<sha256>.json; atomic current.json pointer; lock covers CAS and publication. Hash and byte size checked on every read. Old versions retained; no automatic cleanup.

document.previousRevision: prior SHA-256 or null for initialization

rules: 0..32 projects; unique ID and account; bounded 1..20 unique anchors per project
Existing project ID and account binding immutable; existing projects cannot be removed, disable instead
Same enabled flag drives sidebar and next collector plan
No statement of online account/anchor ownership verification; configuration validation only

http.preflight: POST /api/operations/configuration/preflight; body {expectedRevision, projects}; response {status: READY, expectedRevision, candidateHash}
http.apply: POST /api/operations/configuration/apply; body {expectedRevision, projects, candidateHash}; response {status: CURRENT_VERIFIED, revision, previousRevision, collectorExecution: DISABLED}
http.errors: 400 CONFIG_INVALID, 409 CONFIG_STALE, 403 CONFIG_WRITE_DISABLED or LOCAL_REQUEST_REQUIRED, 503 CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE. No raw exception/value/path leakage.
http.guard: Default one-argument launch stays read-only. Explicit --configuration <private-dir> --allow-local-config-writes opts into writes, binding only 127.0.0.1:18080. Write requests require exact loopback Host and Origin (127.0.0.1 ports 5180/18080), JSON, X-SCSJ-Config-Write: 1; no CORS. No login, no public exposure.
http.ui: Draft changes invalidate preflight; explicit check then save. After save independently GET active revision and refresh sidebar; unknown outcome requires reread, not automatic retry. Configuration panel remains reachable with zero enabled projects. No browser persistent storage of account configuration.

collector.consumer: Read same active snapshot once per plan; project-owned CLI emits private dry-run plan with configuration revision and selected account/anchors/fixed profile; no old config writes, subprocess or network.
collector.meaning: CONFIGURATION_READY_NOT_EXECUTED only, not collection success. Existing collector integration remains pending.

recovery: Retain immutable prior revisions. Rollback by resubmitting prior projects against current revision through same preflight/apply; identity restrictions remain. No editing pointer by hand, no deletion.
